sources.entry: JSON Mapper - Simple macOS app to generate Swift Object Mapper classes from JSON.

summary.one_liner: A simple macOS app that converts JSON data into Swift Object Mapper model classes.
summary.what_it_does: JSON Mapper is a macOS desktop app that takes JSON data and generates model classes for the Object Mapper library. According to the README, it currently targets only Swift, with other languages planned. The author states it was built as an in-house alternative to SwiftyJSONAccelerator, which the team found hard to adapt to their needs. The README does not describe the UI, options, or the exact output format in detail. Developers are credited as Andrey Romanov and Michail Ovchinnikov.
use_cases: generate Swift model classes from JSON
create Object Mapper structs from an API response
speed up writing Codable-style model boilerplate for iOS apps
convert sample JSON into typed Swift classes on a Mac
how_to_run: Install Xcode 8.1 (listed as a build requirement)
Install CocoaPods 1.1.0 (listed as a build requirement)
notable: Generates Object Mapper model classes from JSON input
Built as an alternative to SwiftyJSONAccelerator
Planned support for languages beyond Swift
caveats: Only Swift output is supported at present
README gives no usage instructions or recent maintenance status
